description: The plot illustrates the relationship between the ratio and minFDE20 for different methods. The x-axis is labeled "Ratio" with a linear scale, ranging from 0.1 to 1.0, and tick labels at intervals of 0.2. The y-axis is labeled "minFDE20" with a linear scale, ranging from 0.8 to 1.3, and tick labels at intervals of 0.1. The plot includes five lines, each representing a different method: TrajICL (blue, solid line), Head Tuning (orange, solid line), FT (green, solid line), LoRA 16 (red, solid line), and LoRA 64 (purple, solid line). TrajICL starts at around 0.9 and decreases gradually to approximately 0.85. Head Tuning begins at 1.3 and declines to about 1.05. FT starts at 1.1 and decreases to around 0.8. LoRA 16 begins at 1.2 and decreases to approximately 0.925. LoRA 64 starts at 1.2 and declines to around 0.925. All lines exhibit a downward trend as the ratio increases, with some lines showing a more gradual decline than others.
